meta.description:
Daily sync of Oura Ring data to GitHub Pages health dashboard. Fetches readiness, sleep, activity, stress and HRV → merges with existing Apple Health data → commits health_data.js → generates AI daily insight via Claude → emails daily digest.

Credentials needed:
1. 'Oura Bearer Token' — httpHeaderAuth, Header Name: Authorization, Value: Bearer YOUR_OURA_TOKEN
2. 'GitHub PAT' — httpHeaderAuth, Header Name: Authorization, Value: token YOUR_GITHUB_TOKEN
3. Email SMTP credentials for the Send Email node

Replace YOUR_CLOUDFLARE_WORKER in the Claude node URL.
